summary: Iteration 3: verified new lat_column/lng_column configuration feature on POST/GET/PATCH /api/maps + backwards compatibility with legacy maps. All 28 tests pass (13 new feature/regression + 15 iteration_2 baseline).

endpoints_covered: GET /api/maps/{id} (returns new fields; works for legacy maps without them)
not_end_to_end_testable: GET /api/onedrive/files/{item_id}/sheets/{sheet_name}/data (needs real MS token) - inspected code: returns suggested_lat/lng + sample_rows/headers as expected
GET /api/maps/{id}/data (needs real MS token) - inspected code: uses m.get('lat_column')/m.get('lng_column') with fallback to last-two headers

passed: POST /api/maps with lat_column/lng_column persists them (verified via Mongo, GET list, GET by id)
PATCH /api/maps/{id} with only lat_column preserves lng_column (partial update via exclude_none)
Backwards-compat: legacy map (inserted directly in Mongo without lat/lng) is listable via GET /api/maps and GET /api/maps/{id} without error
DELETE /api/maps/{id} works for new maps and legacy
Regression (iteration_2 baseline, all 15): root, ms_url, callback missing/invalid state, protected 401s, maps CRUD, point overrides, MS_CLIENT_SECRET fix
critical_code_review_comments: server.py map_data (line ~444) raises 400 when lat_col/lng_col not in headers — good, but the error message leaks the entire headers array; consider capping or i18n-ing for production.
sheet_data auto-detect (line ~314) uses substring match 'lat' which will also match unrelated columns like 'plate' or 'flat'. Consider using startswith/regex word-boundary or an exact-name allowlist.

MapUpdate lat_column/lng_column are `Optional[str]` — passing an empty string '' would be persisted and later break map_data because '' won't be in headers. Consider validating min_length=1 or trimming.
oauth_states still has no TTL index (open from iteration_2). After this run 7 states accumulated from unrelated /auth/microsoft/url calls; not cleaned.
PATCH /maps uses model_dump(exclude_none=True) — a user cannot clear lat_column/lng_column by sending null; would need explicit sentinel or separate endpoint if that's desired.
server.py is now ~510 lines — still single-file; consider splitting into routers when adding more features.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_ms_oauth_callback.py (updated test_create_map payload to include lat_column/lng_column so regression stays green)
test_credentials: None used. Sessions are injected directly into MongoDB with TEST_ prefix and cleaned in fixture teardown.
seed_data_creation: Module-scoped fixture inserts one TEST_ session + user; maps created during tests all belong to that TEST_ user and are wiped in teardown. Legacy map (backwards-compat test) inserted directly in mongo, cleaned via user_id wipe. Verified: 0 TEST_ sessions/maps remain after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New feature (configurable lat/lng columns) verified. Two Graph-calling endpoints (/onedrive/files/{id}/sheets/{sheet}/data returning suggested_lat/lng + sample_rows, and /maps/{id}/data with the lat/lng-column-driven point extraction + fallback) still cannot be tested backend-only — they require a real MS access token from a browser OAuth flow. Consider mocking httpx if end-to-end coverage of those is desired. Regression baseline is now /app/backend/tests/ (both files, 28 tests total, ~6s runtime).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — feature verification run, no bug encountered. The existing iteration_2 test_create_map was mechanically broken by the newly required fields and was updated in-place.
